intro: Big Bite Push Ways uses six reels: Orcas appear only on the first and sixth, while Fish and Jackpots occupy reels 2–5. Orcas can have their own multiplier of up to x10.

Hot Zones split symbols landing in them into two parts, and the split remains after they fall out of the zone. Free Spins award between ten and fifteen initial spins depending on the number of Bonus Symbols.
push-gaming-big-bite-push-ways.editorial: Push Ways differs from Big Bite through more than an extra reel: splitting zones and cascades increase the number of available combinations, and the two games have different Jackpot values.

features.title: Orca x10
features.description: Orcas with multipliers of up to x10 collect Fish and Jackpots from the middle four reels.

features.title: Hot Zones
features.description: Stacks of zones split passing symbols; the split elements persist through subsequent cascades.

features.title: Free Spins progression
features.description: Every four Orcas advance the meter, increasing the multiplier and adding spins.

intro: 20 Coins increases the grid to twenty independent reels and adds Sticky to Infinity for Mystery and Jackpot Mystery Symbols.

Chance Level offers three steps, x2, x4 and x6, to increase the chance of triggering Hold the Jackpot. Cash Infinity still holds cash symbols until the bonus, while the original’s stated overall maximum is 1500x.
wazdan-20-coins.editorial: The original 20 Coins should not be confused with Grand Gold: it builds accumulation on twenty positions and three Chance Level settings but does not inherit the additional Collect to Infinity variants of later releases.

features.title: Sticky to Infinity
features.description: Mystery and Jackpot Mystery Symbols can remain until the next bonus series ends.

features.title: Chance Level x2/x4/x6
features.description: Three settings increase the probability of triggering the bonus rather than guaranteeing a cash payout.

features.title: Cash Infinity and Hold the Jackpot
features.description: Accumulated symbols contribute to the holding bonus with a Grand Jackpot of up to 1500x.

intro: In 3 Super Coin Volcanoes, four matches on an active payline trigger Hold & Win. Before the series begins, Super Wheel guarantees a starting effect.
Three volcano features control respins, multipliers and grid expansion: Life restores the counter, Multi Volcano adds multipliers, and Grow opens two rows.
3-oaks-gaming-3-super-coin-volcanoes.editorial: In 3 Super Coin Volcanoes, the volcano type is decisive: Gold Volcano provides x5 multipliers instead of x2 and boosts an already occupied cell by +5.

features.title: Four symbols trigger Hold & Win
features.description: Four matches on an active payline activate the bonus. MINI, MINOR, MAJOR, Mystery, Mystery Jackpot and Collect are available within it; filling the grid can award the Grand Jackpot.

features.title: Life, Multi Volcano and Grow
features.description: Life restores respins, Multi Volcano places between two and six x2 multipliers, and Grow adds two rows. A new multiplier in the same cell increases its combined multiplier by +1.

features.title: Super Wheel and Gold Volcano
features.description: Super Wheel activates before the bonus. Gold Volcano is an enhanced Multi Volcano: it provides x5 multipliers and adds +5 when a multiplier lands in an occupied cell.

intro: Multi Rush uses clusters and accumulating Cell Multipliers of up to x256; special Rush Symbols add a random multiplier of up to x100.
In Free Spins, four Multi Sync Cells can copy the highest multiplier to one another, while Super Bonus starts with x4 in every cell.
bgaming-multi-rush.editorial: Multi Rush separates three purchase modes: the standard bonus, Super Bonus with Multi Sync Cells, and Hyper Spins with an initial x64. A Rush Symbol worth x100 should not be confused with the whole game’s overall maximum win.

features.title: Cell Multipliers and Rush
features.description: Individual cell multipliers grow with wins up to x256. Rush Symbols can appear randomly with an additional value of up to x100.

features.title: Electric Win
features.description: A random feature creates winning clusters on the grid in both the base game and bonus rounds.

features.title: Multi Sync Cells
features.description: In the bonus, the highest multiplier among four special cells can copy to the other three; these cells have a ceiling of x1024.

features.title: Super Bonus and Hyper Spins
features.description: Purchased Super Bonus awards 12 Free Spins with an initial x4; Hyper Spins starts with x64 in every cell. These are separate entries, not the base parameters of an ordinary spin.

intro: The Tree Symbol acts as a Wild Multiplier; after a winning combination it locks, triggers a Respin and gradually expands upwards into the Tree of Life.
A fully grown Tree of Life triggers Circle of Life, where its multiplier can increase several times until a Skull lands.
hacksaw-gaming-circle-of-life.editorial: Circle of Life revolves around a growing Wild: each successful Respin increases the tree, while the fully expanded symbol takes the accumulated multiplier into a separate Circle of Life risk mechanic.

features.title: Tree Wild and expansion
features.description: Tree with a multiplier acts as Wild. After a win it locks, triggers a Respin and grows upwards one row at a time until it fills the reel.

features.title: Circle of Life Wheel
features.description: A fully grown tree activates a wheel with additive or multiplying values. It continues boosting the Tree of Life until a Skull lands, after which the win is calculated.

features.title: Origin, Eternal and Rebirth
features.description: Expanding FS Scatters determine the number of bonus spins. Origin retains the Tree without respins; Eternal locks active reels; Rebirth starts with active reels 2 and 4.

intro: On the 5x5 grid, clusters of four or more matching symbols form wins. Winning symbols are removed, then new symbols fall from above and can trigger another cascade.

Sunflower acts as a Charge Meter: wins gradually light its petals. Each quarter of the meter adds a new Wild to the grid in the order Chicken, Goat, Sheep, Cow. On a random non-win, Rabbit can remove a row, column or low-paying symbols.
playn-go-animal-madness.editorial: Animal Madness turns ordinary cascades into a clear progress meter: each win brings the next animal Wild closer, while Rabbit offers a chance to revive an unsuccessful spin by destroying part of the grid.

features.title: Sunflower Charge Meter and Rabbit
features.description: Cluster wins charge Sunflower and add four different Wilds in stages, while Rabbit destroys a row, column or low-paying symbols on a random non-win.

features.title: Sunflower and four Wilds
features.description: Clusters charge Sunflower’s petals; each quarter brings the next Wild: Chicken, Goat, Sheep, Cow.

features.title: Rabbit on a non-winning grid
features.description: Random Rabbit assistance removes a row, column or some low-paying symbols, allowing a new cascade sequence to begin.

intro: Bison Battle links red bison on the same line: a Red Bison carrying a prize clashes with a Red Bison carrying a multiplier, multiplying the prize value. The second bison’s colour can send the game into a different bonus.
A blue Bison together with a red multiplier opens Ice Park with held Coins, while a green one opens Green Valley with Walking Bison and Sticky Wild. These modes have different extension rules.
push-gaming-bison-battle.editorial: Bison Battle’s two bonuses are not interchangeable: Ice Park starts with three spins and holds coins, while Green Valley starts with eight and boosts Sticky Wilds on matching rows.

features.title: Bison Clash
features.description: A red bison carrying a value and a red one carrying a multiplier on the same row combine for an immediate payout.

features.title: Ice Park
features.description: Three starting spins, held coins and a Red Bison multiplier; a new symbol resets the series.

features.title: Green Valley
features.description: Eight Free Spins with Walking Bison, Sticky Wild and extra spins when they land together.

intro: 20 Coins Grand Gold Edition uses twenty positions for Hold the Jackpot, retaining Cash Infinity and Mystery Symbols that stay until the bonus.
A higher Grand Jackpot of up to 2000x distinguishes Gold from the original 1500x. Chance Level helps reach the main bonus more often but does not change the number of reels.
wazdan-20-coins-grand-gold-edition.editorial: This version strengthens the original twenty-position system without automatically becoming 25 Coins with Cluster Collector or Platinum with Cash Out.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot 2000x
features.description: Filled cash positions contribute to the bonus with a higher Grand Jackpot limit.

features.title: Cash Infinity
features.description: Preserves special cash values between ordinary play and the bonus.

features.title: Sticky to Infinity and Chance Level
features.description: Mystery Symbols can remain until the bonus, while Chance Level adjusts the chance of triggering it.

intro: In 3 Super Hot Chillies, pepper meters activate Hold & Win.
Before the bonus, Super Wheel guarantees a starting effect.
3-oaks-gaming-3-super-hot-chillies.editorial: The Wheel can add a feature, bonus symbols or one of the jackpots.

features.title: Multi, Double and Extra
features.description: The features add multipliers, a second grid and four respins.

features.title: Super Wheel
features.description: Before Hold & Win, the wheel awards an extra reward.

features.title: Combined activation
features.description: All three features activate when all three meters are filled.

intro: Mystic Reels centres on twenty paylines and the Cascade+ system: winning symbols disappear, making room for new ones and advancing the sequence towards the bonus.
Encore Stones below the grid can award a respin, while individual Wilds in Free Spins increase their reel’s multiplier by up to x5.
bgaming-mystic-reels.editorial: Mystic Reels differs from a conventional Scatter bonus: its Free Spins count depends on Cascade+ and can start at 7, 10, 12, 18 or 25. Encore at a higher stake changes the chance of respins and the route to the bonus.

features.title: Cascade+ and paylines
features.description: Winning combinations across 20 paylines disappear and new symbols fall into their places; cascades can lead to respins and Free Spins.

features.title: Encore Stones and Encore mode
features.description: Active stones below the grid award extra respins, while Encore increases the total stake by 50% for expanded bonus opportunities.

features.title: Free Spins and Wild Multipliers
features.description: The Cascade+ bonus can award 7–25 starting spins and retriggers. Each Wild increases its reel’s multiplier by +1 up to x5.

features.title: Bonus purchase
features.description: Buy Bonus costing x100 the stake guarantees ten Free Spins with possible extensions through Cascade+, rather than a single fixed prize.

intro: The spin’s wins collect in the Total Win Bar, while Multiplier Symbols activate after cascades and apply to the total.
Normal, Super and Epic Multipliers grow differently during cascades; Divine Boost also accumulates their values in a Progressive Divine Multiplier.
hacksaw-gaming-cloud-princess.editorial: Cloud Princess separates cascade wins from their enhancement: the Total Win Bar gathers the amount, while several classes of Multiplier Symbols develop through cascades and then apply to the final win.

features.title: Total Win Bar
features.description: Every win in a cascade sequence is added to the Total Win Bar above the grid. Multipliers apply to the accumulated amount only after the spin ends.

features.title: Normal, Super and Epic Multipliers
features.description: Normal increases by +1 per cascade, Super by +2, and Epic doubles with each cascade. Their values add together first, then apply to the Total Win Bar.

features.title: Cloud Surge and Divine Boost
features.description: Three FS symbols unlock Cloud Surge with ten Spins. Four FS symbols award Divine Boost: the Progressive Divine Multiplier retains values from winning spins and accumulates until the bonus ends.

intro: Anubis Wilds can activate randomly on any base spin and add Wild symbols before the reels stop. This feature alone does not guarantee a win.

Three, four or five Scatters award 10, 15 or 20 Free Spins respectively. Five Ankh symbols must be collected in Free Spins to summon Anubis Wilds again; collection progress persists between spins. Additional Scatters extend the bonus.
playn-go-ankh-of-anubis.editorial: Ankh of Anubis separates random assistance in the base game from accumulation in the bonus: Anubis Wilds arrives without preparation in ordinary play, while Free Spins gradually collect five Ankhs for a guaranteed activation of the same power.

features.title: Anubis Wilds and Ankh Collection
features.description: Random Anubis Wilds adds Wilds in the base game, 3–5 Scatters award 10–20 Free Spins, and five collected Ankhs reactivate the Wild feature in the bonus.

features.title: Scatter and Free Spins
features.description: Three, four and five Scatters award 10, 15 and 20 free spins respectively.

features.title: Ankh Collection
features.description: Collecting five Ankhs in Free Spins activates Anubis Wilds; collection progress persists between bonus spins.

intro: Blaze of Ra uses five reels and 40 paylines. Wild Ra in the top two positions can activate a two-position downward nudge of the reel, keeping Wild on the grid.
Three Scarab Scatters anywhere trigger Free Games; each Scatter shows a number that helps determine the series. In the bonus, reels 1, 3 and 5 are entirely filled with Wild Ra.
push-gaming-blaze-of-ra.editorial: Wild Ra does more than substitute for ordinary symbols here: Nudging Wilds shifts a specific reel, while Free Games turns the three odd-numbered reels into persistent Wilds.

features.title: Nudging Wilds
features.description: Ra in the upper positions causes its reel to nudge down by two cells.

features.title: Scarab Scatter
features.description: Three or more Scarabs award free spins according to the revealed numbers.

features.title: Three Wild reels
features.description: In Free Games, reels 1, 3 and 5 remain filled with Ra, while new Scarabs can add spins.

intro: 24 Coins was the first Coins release with Moving Cash Out: an accumulating cash label moves around the grid and allows values to be collected in the base mode.

Cluster Collector also collects neighbouring symbol values, while Hold the Jackpot uses 24 positions with a maximum Grand Jackpot of 1200x. Cash Infinity and Chance Level control accumulation and bonus triggering.
wazdan-24-coins.editorial: Moving Cash Out, rather than simply the reel count, distinguishes 24 Coins. Cluster Collector gathers neighbouring values, while Moving Cash Out conducts a separate collection in the base game.

features.title: Moving Cash Out
features.description: A moving cash label gives the base game its own accumulation mechanic.

features.title: Cluster Collector
features.description: Collects cash values from neighbouring symbols and adds them to the prize.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot 1200x
features.description: The bonus fills 24 positions; the provider states a win limit of 1200x the stake.

intro: In 3 Super Hot Teapots, coloured symbols fill three teapots. A full meter triggers Hold & Win with the corresponding features.
Boost increases visible symbol values, Double opens a second grid, and Multi places multipliers. Super Wheel determines one of the starting effects before the bonus.
3-oaks-gaming-3-super-hot-teapots.editorial: In 3 Super Hot Teapots, the filled teapots are worth watching: they determine which features are active in Hold & Win, while repeat multipliers grow by +1.

features.title: Three progress teapots
features.description: Red, blue and purple teapots fill with matching symbols. A full meter triggers Hold & Win with MINI, MINOR and MAJOR; filling 15 positions awards the Grand Jackpot.

features.title: Boost, Double and Multi
features.description: Boost adds a random value to all visible symbols, Double opens a second grid, and Multi places multipliers in random cells. A repeat landing increases the cell’s multiplier by +1.

features.title: Super Wheel sets the start
features.description: Before the bonus game, Super Wheel guarantees one of the starting effects: a jackpot, an additional feature or bonus symbols.

intro: Red Hot Chilli Chickens combines three separate Chilli Pot meters: filling them unlocks Colossal Free Spins, Jackpot Free Spins or Hold & Win.
If several pots trigger on one spin, the game can combine two or all three bonuses; these are not equivalent to ordinary free spins.
bgaming-red-hot-chilli-chickens.editorial: The bonus combination matters here. Colossal provides a giant 3×3 symbol, Jackpot collects coloured peppers to thresholds, and Hold & Win uses Prize symbols and a Collector that adds attempts.

features.title: Three pots and Triple Bonus
features.description: Mystery can reveal one of three Chilli Symbols, which charge different pots. Multiple triggers together award a double or triple bonus.

features.title: Colossal Free Spins
features.description: On reels 2–4, a large 3×3 symbol appears on every bonus spin.

features.title: Jackpot Free Spins
features.description: Collecting 3 blue, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 yellow or 7 red peppers leads to the corresponding Mini, Minor, Major, Mega or Max.

features.title: Hold & Win Collector
features.description: Respins feature Prize Symbols worth up to x1000 and a Collector that gathers them and adds one, two or three attempts.

intro: A Curse Symbol spreads its curse upwards to the top cell of the reel, creating Cursed Positions that are then replaced with random symbols.
Wrath of Sobek features more frequent Curse Symbols, while Tomb of Tutankhamun restricts Cursed Position replacements to high-paying symbols and Wilds.
hacksaw-gaming-cursed-crypt.editorial: Cursed Crypt revolves around Curse spreading vertically: one symbol changes several positions above it, while the two bonuses improve these replacements in different ways.

features.title: Cursed Reels
features.description: A Curse Symbol spreads upwards to the reel’s top row, creating Cursed Positions. All affected positions then reveal random symbols.

features.title: Wrath of Sobek
features.description: Three FS symbols award ten Spins with a higher chance of Curse Symbols. Two additional FS symbols add two spins; three add another four.

features.title: Tomb of Tutankhamun
features.description: Four FS symbols award ten Spins where Curse can replace Cursed Positions only with high-paying symbols or Wilds, rather than any symbol type.

intro: Anubis Wilds can again randomly add Wild symbols in ordinary play. On a non-winning spin, an Ankh and Wild combination triggers Anubis Re-Spins: Wilds lock and expand vertically to cover the entire reel.
Re-Spins continue until all held Wilds become Stacked Wilds. Three or more Scatters award up to 20 Free Spins; Anubis Wilds and Re-Spins also work within the bonus, while new Scatters add spins.
playn-go-ankh-of-anubis-awakening.editorial: Awakening extends the original mechanic with a separate Re-Spin system. A Wild no longer simply appears on the grid: it stays, expands to fill a reel and can develop a sequence even within Free Spins.

features.title: Anubis Re-Spins and Expanding Wilds
features.description: Ankh + Wild on a non-win triggers Re-Spins with sticky Wilds that expand across the full reel; Free Spins retain both Wilds and the Re-Spin mechanic.

features.title: Re-Spins from Ankh + Wild
features.description: On a non-winning spin, an Ankh and Wild combination triggers respins with held Wilds.

features.title: Wild expansion
features.description: During Re-Spins, held Wilds expand across their entire reels; this effect continues in Free Spins.

intro: Boss Bear develops a Reveal Symbol system: green symbols reveal random paying symbols, while three adjacent Reveal stacks turn golden and trigger the Coin Feature.
Panda pays for just two matches. In the bonus, Scatters gradually convert low-paying symbols into Reveal symbols, while new levels raise coin multipliers to x3, x5 and x10.
push-gaming-boss-bear.editorial: Boss Bear differs from a conventional hold-and-spin slot: the Coin Feature comes from Golden Reveal, while Free Spins progress transforms the symbols on the reels.

features.title: Panda for two matches
features.description: Panda is the game’s only symbol that pays for a combination of just two.

features.title: Golden Reveal
features.description: Three adjacent Reveal stacks turn golden and reveal coins worth up to x5000.

features.title: Reshaping Free Spins
features.description: Scatters charge a meter that changes low-paying symbols, strengthening coin multipliers.

intro: 25 Coins uses a grid of 25 separate positions and introduces Cluster Collector, which collects the cash-symbol values around it.

Cash Infinity carries special values into the bonus, while Sticky to Infinity holds Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols until it ends. The original version’s Hold the Jackpot is linked to a maximum of 2000x the stake.
wazdan-25-coins.editorial: In the original 25 Coins, Collector gathers neighbouring values, but Collect to Infinity with its indefinite holding belongs to the separate Grand Gold Edition.

features.title: Cluster Collector
features.description: Receives adjacent Cash Symbol values and boosts the collection result on the 25-position grid.

features.title: Sticky to Infinity
features.description: Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols can remain on the grid until the next bonus series ends.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot 2000x
features.description: The holding mode collects bonus values with a maximum of 2000x the stake.

intro: In 4 African Drums, diamonds fill four drum meters, after which Hold & Win begins. Master Drum can give the bonus a separate enhancement.
Collect gathers values, Multi adds multipliers, and Extra reveals two more rows. Filling the expanded grid makes the Extra Grand Jackpot available.
3-oaks-gaming-4-african-drums.editorial: 4 African Drums’ main feature is Master Drum: it can add up to three bonus symbols during respins, including jackpot symbols.

features.title: Four drum meters
features.description: Diamonds fill the matching drum meters and trigger Hold & Win. MINI, MINOR, MAJOR and GRAND can land in the bonus; filling the grid can also award the Grand Jackpot.

features.title: Collect, Multi and Extra
features.description: Collect gathers values, Multi adds multipliers to empty cells, and Extra opens two additional rows and can duplicate a symbol between them. Filling the expanded grid awards the Extra Grand Jackpot.

features.title: Master Drum during respins
features.description: Master Drum can activate at any point during respins and add up to three bonus symbols, including jackpots. It can also activate drum features in the base game.

intro: Reel of Ra uses 243 ways to win and a separate coin series of seven Free Spins: only Coins land in the bonus instead of ordinary symbols.
After coins are collected, a separate Multiplier Reel increases the spin result by x1, x2, x3 or x5, while filling the entire grid is linked to the Grand Prize.
bgaming-reel-of-ra.editorial: Reel of Ra’s distinction is not to confuse the Mega Prize Coin with the reel multiplier: the x100 coin is counted separately, while the Multiplier Reel applies to the ordinary coin total for that specific bonus spin.

features.title: Coin trigger
features.description: Three or more Coin Symbols unlock the bonus with seven free spins; entry is also available through Buy Bonus.

features.title: Seven Coin-only Free Spins
features.description: Only Coins appear in the bonus, with their values gathered in the lower counter; the Multiplier Reel selects x1, x2, x3 or x5 for the spin result.

features.title: Mega Prize Coin x100
features.description: A separate coin worth x100 is not multiplied by the upper Multiplier Reel, unlike the ordinary Coin Symbol total.

features.title: Grand for filling the grid
features.description: If coins occupy every position, Grand x1000 is awarded, but if the multiplied coin total is larger, the higher of the two values is paid.

intro: The Diamond Symbol acts as a Wild with an Additive Multiplier and triggers a Dandy Respin, during which all Diamonds become Sticky.
Several Diamonds in a square merge into a Colossal Diamond, while Bolt and Epic Bolt Symbols increase ordinary and Colossal Diamond multipliers.
hacksaw-gaming-dandy-diamonds.editorial: Dandy Diamonds develops one positional mechanic: Sticky Diamonds extend respins, square groups merge into a Colossal Diamond, and Bolts increase their multipliers.

features.title: Diamond Wild and Dandy Respins
features.description: Diamond acts as Wild with an additive multiplier, triggers a Re-Spin and remains sticky. A new Diamond extends the sequence; multiple multipliers in one win add together.

features.title: Colossal Diamonds
features.description: A square group of Diamonds measuring 2×2 or larger merges into one Colossal Diamond with the combined multiplier total. A new outer square of Diamonds can increase its size further.

features.title: Bolt and Epic Bolt
features.description: An ordinary Bolt boosts Diamonds within a 3×3 area, while Epic Bolt boosts Diamonds across the entire grid. In Play with Safire, Diamonds become sticky for the whole bonus and retain progressive multipliers.

intro: In the base game, a random feature expands Wild symbols across their entire reels. If the expansion produces neither a win nor another feature trigger, a re-spin is awarded and the Expanded Wild stays in place.

Three Bonus symbols unlock Fun Palace with doll picks and hidden prizes. Three Scatters, or a Scatter inside Fun Palace, trigger Set the World on Fire with 8 Free Spins: an Expanded Wild moves between reels and leaves a fiery trail that can turn into extra Wilds.
playn-go-annihilator.editorial: Annihilator uses Expanded Wild differently in its two modes: in the base game it holds its position through re-spins, while in Free Spins it becomes a moving source of a Wild trail. Fun Palace provides an alternative entry to the main bonus.

features.title: Expanded Wild, Fun Palace and Set the World on Fire
features.description: Base-game Wilds expand and can award sticky re-spins, Fun Palace offers pick prizes, and Free Spins use a moving Expanded Wild and fiery trail.

features.title: Fun Palace Pick Bonus
features.description: Three Bonus Symbols allow dolls with hidden prizes to be picked; a Scatter within the feature can lead to Free Spins.

features.title: Set the World on Fire
features.description: Three Scatters award eight Free Spins; a moving Expanding Wild leaves a fiery trail with additional Wilds.

intro: Candy Blast uses cascades and a Total Multiplier Meter: each winning cascade doubles the overall multiplier, which applies to all combinations. A losing cascade resets it.
Three Rainbow Cupcakes trigger eight Free Spins with a x2 multiplier; four award ten with x4; five award twelve with x8. Extra Life works on losing cascades, while Multiplier Boost helps on wins.
push-gaming-candy-blast.editorial: In Candy Blast, distinguish continuous doubling within a winning sequence from the bonus’s special Multiplier Strike Out, which removes the last active level after three consecutive wins.

features.title: Doubling the Total Multiplier
features.description: Each new winning cascade doubles the current sequence’s multiplier.

features.title: Rainbow Cupcake
features.description: The Scatter count determines the initial Free Spins length and a x2, x4 or x8 multiplier.

features.title: Extra Life and Strike Out
features.description: Extra Life can activate on a losing cascade; Strike Out changes the multiplier ladder after three wins.

intro: 25 Coins Grand Gold Edition adds the new Collect to Infinity feature to Cluster Collector: the modified Collector stays active until the next bonus round ends.
Sticky to Infinity holds Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols, while Cash Infinity accumulates cash values. Hold the Jackpot raises the Grand Jackpot to 2500x the stake.
wazdan-25-coins-grand-gold-edition.editorial: This Grand Gold Edition does more than raise the maximum win: Collect to Infinity changes the Collector’s lifetime and distinguishes it from the original 25 Coins.

features.title: Collect to Infinity
features.description: A special modifier keeps Cluster Collector until the next bonus ends.

features.title: Enhanced Cluster Collector
features.description: Collects neighbouring symbol values and can receive additional changes from modifiers.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot 2500x
features.description: The holding series uses a Grand Jackpot of up to 2500x; Chance Level offers trigger-probability settings.

intro: In 4 Clover Pots, three small pots fill with clovers and prepare features for Hold & Win. A fourth large pot unlocks a separate Super Bonus.
Multi, Collect and Mystery change values in the ordinary bonus, while Super Pot expands the grid by two rows and activates between one and three features.
3-oaks-gaming-4-clover-pots.editorial: 4 Clover Pots has two bonus levels: ordinary Hold & Win is linked to the three small pots, while Super Pot leads to an expanded grid and a Super Jackpot of 10,000x.

features.title: Three small pots
features.description: Purple, blue and red pots fill with clovers and trigger Hold & Win. MINI, MINOR and MAJOR are available in the bonus; filling the grid can award the Grand Jackpot.

features.title: Multi, Collect and Mystery
features.description: Multi places a multiplier of up to x5 on an empty cell, Collect gathers current values, and Mystery can reveal a high-value bonus symbol or a jackpot from MINI to MAJOR.

features.title: Super Pot 10,000x
features.description: The fourth large pot triggers Super Bonus with one, two or three features and adds two rows. Filling all 25 cells can award the Super Jackpot of 10,000x the stake.

intro: St. Patrick's Pots Hold and Win gradually charges three independent Feature Pots in the base game: Boost, Minimum Coin and Jackpot.
Up to three enhancements work together in Hold & Win; changing the stake resets the visible progress, but returning to the previous stake restores its corresponding pots.
bgaming-st-patricks-pots-hold-and-win.editorial: The main point is to understand each pot’s accumulated level rather than simply trigger Hold & Win. Boost increases coins, Minimum Coin raises the minimum denomination, and Jackpot improves the smaller jackpots while keeping Major and Grand fixed.

features.title: Three accumulating Feature Pots
features.description: Boost Pot grows from x2 to x10, Minimum Coin from x3 to x10, and Jackpot Pot improves Mini and Minor; progress is recorded separately for different stake sizes.

features.title: Hold & Win with three respins
features.description: Special Symbols can improve a pot or trigger the bonus at its current level. Coin Symbols and jackpots collect during respins.

features.title: Boost, Minimum Coin and Jackpot
features.description: Boost increases coin values; Minimum Coin sets the lower threshold; Jackpot changes Mini/Minor, while Major x200 and Grand x500 remain fixed.

features.title: Buy Bonus and Chance x2
features.description: Purchased variants start with one or three enhancements at random levels, while Chance x2 separately increases the probability of Special Symbols.

intro: A Danny Symbol contributing to a win expands upwards into a Wild Dollar-Reel; if the expansion passes through a Wild, a reel multiplier appears, and multiple such multipliers add together.
After expansion, Nudge Symbols move Dollar-Reels down one position; in No Bills, No Thrills, their values also collect in a Progressive Global Multiplier.
hacksaw-gaming-danny-dollar.editorial: Danny Dollar centres on vertical Dollar-Reels: a win can expand the Wild area, create a reel multiplier and then move it through the Nudge mechanic.

features.title: Dollar-Reels and Wild multipliers
features.description: A winning Danny expands upwards into a Wild Dollar-Reel. If the expansion passes through a Wild, a multiplier applies to the entire reel; multiple Reel Multiplier values add together.

features.title: Nudge and Dollar Dash
features.description: A Nudge Symbol moves an expanded Dollar-Reel down one row. Dollar Dash uses Reel Indicators that restrict where Danny can appear and encourage longer Dollar-Reels.

features.title: No Bills, No Thrills
features.description: The second Free Spins series introduces a Progressive Global Multiplier that gathers all Dollar-Reel multipliers and applies them to wins in subsequent bonus spins.

intro: Three Owl Scatters trigger Free Spins. The bonus continues as long as at least one Wild remains on the reels, so its duration depends on Wild symbols being present rather than only a fixed spin count.

Multiplier Wilds become sticky in Free Spins and move upwards after each spin, increasing their own multiplier up to x4. The official page also states that the maximum combined multiplier potential grows to x64.
playn-go-athena-ascending.editorial: Athena Ascending makes Wild both a bonus timer and a source of a growing multiplier. Free Spins continue while at least one Wild remains on the grid, and each subsequent spin increases the value of held Wilds.

features.title: Ascending Multiplier Wilds
features.description: Free Spins continue while a Wild is present; sticky Multiplier Wilds climb the reels and strengthen on each spin up to x4.

features.title: Owl Scatter and bonus duration
features.description: Three Owl Scatters trigger Free Spins, which continue as long as at least one Wild remains on the reels.

features.title: Ascending Multiplier Wild
features.description: A held Wild moves upwards after a spin and increases its own multiplier up to x4; a combination can produce x64 potential.

intro: Cats of Olympuss uses Coin and Wild: three or more of these symbols in a combination pay from left to right. Three Scatters on the central reels unlock Progressive Free Spins with card picks.
More Scatters at the trigger make more upgrade cards available. During free spins, every five special coins unlock the next reel setup and trigger another Card Pick.
push-gaming-cats-of-olympuss.editorial: This slot builds its bonus around more than a simple retrigger: collecting special Coins takes the player to the next grid level and provides a new choice of upgrades.

features.title: Coin and Wild
features.description: Coins and Wilds contribute to combinations of three or more consecutive symbols, counted from left to right.

features.title: Card Pick
features.description: On entry, a spin-count card and additional Upgrade Cards are selected; their number depends on the Scatters.

features.title: Five special Coins
features.description: Collecting five special coins unlocks the next reel set and another card pick.

intro: 25 Coins x3000 starts Hold the Jackpot with three respins: each new symbol resets the counter to three, while filling all twenty-five cells awards the Grand Jackpot of 3000x the stake.

Cash Infinity holds values from 5x to 10x until the bonus; an improved Cluster Collector gathers neighbouring cash-symbol values for five spins. Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols can be held by Sticky to Infinity.
wazdan-25-coins-x3000.editorial: In x3000, the 3000x in the name matters alongside Cluster Collector’s specific five turns and Cash Infinity carry-over. These rules are confirmed by Wazdan’s release of 1 October 2026.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot respins
features.description: Three starting respins reset with a new symbol; filling 25 cells awards the Grand Jackpot of 3000x.

features.title: Cluster Collector for five spins
features.description: The collector receives neighbouring Cash and Cash Infinity Symbol values for up to five spins.

features.title: Cash Infinity and Sticky to Infinity
features.description: Cash values of 5x–10x and Mystery Symbols can persist until the next bonus series.

intro: In 4 Fairy Flowers, progress symbols open three flowers and trigger Hold & Win. A fourth flower unlocks a separate Magic Bonus.
Extra, Collect and Multi change values in the bonus, while Magic Bonus expands the grid and allows the fairy to add symbols or restore respins.
3-oaks-gaming-4-fairy-flowers.editorial: The main reference in 4 Fairy Flowers is awakening the fourth flower: it moves the game into Magic Bonus with extra rows and at least one active feature.

features.title: Three flowers trigger Hold & Win
features.description: Red, purple and green flowers fill with progress symbols. Fully opening at least one flower activates Hold & Win with MINI, MINOR and MAJOR; filling the grid awards the Grand Jackpot.

features.title: Extra, Collect and Multi
features.description: Extra reveals a cash value, Collect gathers current values, and Multi provides multipliers. A Mystery Symbol can also activate an inactive feature.

features.title: The fourth flower’s Magic Bonus
features.description: Magic Progress Symbols awaken the fourth flower. Magic Bonus starts with at least one feature, expands the grid by two rows, and allows the fairy to add symbols and restore respins.

intro: Stars & Stripes Hold and Win combines Trueways, Free Spins with Wild multipliers and Coin Respin, which triggers from six Coin Symbols.
Dynamite in Coin Respin splits large cells, gradually increasing the number of coin positions; Mega Jackpot requires a separate unlock and all 48 cells to be filled.
bgaming-stars-and-stripes-hold-and-win.editorial: The official page restricts this game’s availability on certain servers. Availability at every operator cannot be assumed; in the mechanic itself, Mini/Major arrive with Coins, while Mega requires Collect and filling the expanded grid.

features.title: Coin Respin and three respins
features.description: Six or more coins activate Coin Respin, and new coins are held; a new Coin or Dynamite resets the counter to three attempts.

features.title: Dynamite expands the grid
features.description: During respins, Dynamite splits a medium or large cell into two, creating extra coin positions.

features.title: Free Spins and Wild Multipliers
features.description: Four, five or six Scatters award 12, 15 or 20 spins; Free Spins Wilds carry x2, x3 or x5, adding together for winning combinations.

features.title: Mega Jackpot conditions
features.description: Collect first unlocks Mega, after which all 48 positions must be filled with coins. Mini and Major have separate Jackpot Coins.

intro: Summoning Symbols come in three sizes and reveal stacks of matching paying symbols or Wilds; if a Summoning Symbol contributes to a win, it remains on the grid after the cascade.
A Wild directly above or below a Summoning Symbol increases its size; in Twisted, all Summoning Symbols become Sticky and reveal new stacks on every spin.
hacksaw-gaming-dark-spiral.editorial: Dark Spiral combines cascades with growing Summoning Symbols: they do more than survive a winning cascade, as a neighbouring Wild can expand them before they reveal their contents again.

features.title: Summoning Symbols and cascades
features.description: Summoning Symbols come in three sizes and reveal vertical stacks of identical symbols or Wilds. After contributing to a win, they survive the cascade and can reveal a new stack.

features.title: Expanding Summoning through Wild
features.description: A Wild immediately above or below a Summoning Symbol on the same reel increases its size, allowing its coverage to grow between cascades.

features.title: Shattered, Twisted and Tortured
features.description: Three FS symbols award Shattered with frequent Summoning Symbols; four award Twisted with Sticky Summoning on every spin; five award Hidden Epic Tortured with enhanced Twisted rules.

intro: Three Pyramid Bonus symbols trigger Pick-the-Idols: the player picks golden idols and receives prizes until a poisonous-gas trap ends the feature.

Three Sunstone Scatters trigger Free Spins. Before they begin, Sunstone randomly selects an ordinary symbol as Extra Scatter and determines the free-spin count at the same time. During the bonus, that symbol pays as a Scatter according to its ordinary paytable.
playn-go-aztec-idols.editorial: Aztec Idols uses two independent bonuses: Pyramid provides a risky pick round with instant rewards, while Sunstone turns an ordinary symbol into an additional Scatter for the entire Free Spins series.

features.title: Pick-the-Idols and Sunstone Free Spins
features.description: Pyramid unlocks a pick feature that lasts until a trap, while Sunstone selects an Extra Scatter and a Free Spins count for a separate bonus mode.

features.title: Pick-the-Idols
features.description: Three Pyramid Scatters unlock golden idol picks; a poisonous trap ends the prize selection.

features.title: Sunstone and Extra Scatter
features.description: Three Sunstones award Free Spins in which a selected ordinary symbol becomes Extra Scatter and pays according to its own paytable.

intro: Crystal Catcher pays for clusters of five or more adjacent crystals of one colour. Each colour has its own prize value, while Wild Beetle can jump between special Crystals and leave golden copies.
Each Beetle jump increases its multiplier by +1. A Beetle appearing beside a Bonus Symbol triggers seven Free Spins in a lava area with active Beetles retained.
push-gaming-crystal-catcher.editorial: Crystal Catcher does not use an ordinary Scatter trigger: the meeting of a Wild Beetle and a Bonus Symbol takes the game into Free Spins, while the jump sequence forms a separate multiplier progression.

features.title: Clusters of five or more
features.description: Five or more adjacent crystals of the same colour award the corresponding payout value.

features.title: Jumping Wild Beetle
features.description: The beetle collects Crystals and leaves a Gold Beetle with its previous multiplier, increasing its own value after the next jump.

features.title: Seven Free Spins
features.description: A Beetle and Bonus Symbol combination unlocks the bonus in the lava area.

intro: 30 Coins adds thirty positions for Hold the Jackpot and a Cluster Collector that gathers neighbouring cash-symbol values.
Cash Infinity holds prizes until the bonus, while Sticky to Infinity locks Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols. The original’s stated Grand Jackpot is 1500x the stake.
wazdan-30-coins.editorial: Cluster Collector performs ordinary adjacent collection here rather than working with Collect to Infinity. That modifier appeared in the later Grand Gold Edition.

features.title: Cluster Collector
features.description: Collects neighbouring cash values on the thirty-position grid.

features.title: Sticky to Infinity
features.description: Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols can remain until the next bonus ends.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot 1500x
features.description: Held symbols collect in the bonus series; the original’s verified maximum is 1500x.

intro: In 4 Fortune Clovers, matches fill four clover meters and trigger Hold & Win. Fortune Situation before the bonus can increase the starting clover count.
Expand enlarges the grid to 5×6, Multi awards multipliers, Boost adds values, and Collect gathers every visible prize.
3-oaks-gaming-4-fortune-clovers.editorial: In 4 Fortune Clovers, the quality of a trigger depends on Fortune Situation: it can bring the starting bonus-symbol count to six and randomly activate additional features.

features.title: Four clover meters
features.description: Matching symbols fill four meters and trigger Hold & Win. MINI, MINOR and MAJOR can appear in the bonus, while a full clover grid awards the Grand Jackpot.

features.title: Expand, Multi, Boost and Collect
features.description: Expand opens extra rows up to a 5×6 grid, Multi awards multipliers, Boost adds a random value to up to three symbols, and Collect gathers every visible prize.

features.title: Fortune Situation
features.description: Before the bonus, Fortune Situation can grow additional clovers up to six bonus symbols and randomly activate extra features. A Mystery Symbol also turns into one of the feature symbols.

intro: Sweet Samurai is a fruit slot with five asymmetric reels: they carry 3×4×3×4×3 symbols respectively.
Wins form across adjacent reels from left to right using Ways Pays, while Broccoli Samurai comes alive during large payouts in the Win Slice animation.
bgaming-sweet-samurai.editorial: Sweet Samurai has no verified Free Spins, Bonus Buy or Hold & Win. The base game is the entire profile here: unusual reel heights, left-to-right combinations and the top-paying Golden Pineapple.

features.title: Asymmetric 3×4×3×4×3 layout
features.description: Reels 1, 3, 5 have three positions each, while 2 and 4 have four; this is not a conventional uniform 5×3 or 5×4 grid.

features.title: Ways Pays from left to right
features.description: Matching symbols on adjacent reels pay from left to right without fixed paylines; the longest combination of that symbol is counted.

features.title: Golden Pineapple
features.description: Golden Pineapple is the highest-paying ordinary symbol; its appearance in a winning sequence affects the payout according to the base paytable.

features.title: Win Slice and no bonus round
features.description: On large wins, Broccoli Samurai slices fruit in the Win Slice animation. The provider does not describe separate Free Spins or a Buy Feature.

intro: Super Cascade removes every symbol of the winning type and refills the cleared positions; Wild Symbols can carry multipliers used in calculating the combination.
Unholy Symbols collect throughout the round, while Rise to Salvation reverses cascades upwards and adds persistent Lost Soul Symbols with a Global Multiplier or Cash Prize.
hacksaw-gaming-dark-summoning.editorial: Dark Summoning develops cascades through two opposing bonus scenarios: Hellfire turns marked positions into Wilds, while Rise to Salvation reverses movement and makes Lost Souls rise towards the top row.

features.title: Super Cascade and Wild Multipliers
features.description: After calculation, every symbol of the winning type is removed, and newly falling symbols fill the empty cells. Wild contributes to combinations and can carry a separate multiplier.

features.title: Unholy, Order and Trial by Hellfire
features.description: Three Unholy symbols collected in one base round unlock ten Trial by Hellfire spins. Unholy turns marked Hellfire positions into Wilds, while Order replaces other symbols with Wilds in the base game.

features.title: Rise to Salvation and Lost Souls
features.description: Collecting the third Unholy together with Order activates Rise to Salvation. In this bonus version, cascades move upwards, and a Lost Soul reaching the top row adds a Global Multiplier or awards a Cash Prize.

intro: Three or more Aztec Warrior Princess symbols trigger between 15 and 25 Free Spins. Princess becomes Wild in the bonus and remains Wild for the entire series.

Three jewel-eyed Skull symbols unlock a separate temple pick bonus. The player chooses three artefacts, collecting sets of skulls at different value levels, including bronze, silver, gold and diamond.
playn-go-aztec-warrior-princess.editorial: Aztec Warrior Princess separates its mechanic into a long Free Spins series with a consistent Princess Wild and a separate pick bonus through Skulls. These features remain distinct and provide two different bonus rhythms.

features.title: Princess Free Spins and Skull Bonus
features.description: 3+ Princess symbols award 15–25 Free Spins with Wild Princess, while three Skull symbols trigger a temple pick feature with artefact sets.

features.title: Free Spins with Princess Wild
features.description: Three or more Aztec Warrior Princess symbols award 15–25 Free Spins. Princess remains Wild throughout the series in this mode.

features.title: Skull Temple Pick
features.description: Three jewel-decorated Skull Symbols activate an independent temple bonus with artefact picks.

features.title: Bronze and diamond skull sets
features.description: In the temple pick, the player chooses three artefacts; the set’s value depends on its skull types: bronze, silver, gold or diamond.

intro: Deadly 5 uses Sheriff Badge as Wild, substituting for all ordinary symbols except Safe. Three, four and five Safe Scatters award 10, 15 and 20 Free Spins respectively, plus different instant prizes.
During Sheriff's Bonus, the sheriff Wild locks on the fifth reel. On the other reels, an outlaw portrait matching the Wanted Poster above activates Expanding Symbols.
push-gaming-deadly-5.editorial: Deadly 5 builds its bonus around a specific outlaw matching a poster, rather than random expansion of any symbols. The fifth reel remains a separate persistent Wild support.

features.title: Sheriff Badge
features.description: Wild substitutes for paying symbols but not Safe Scatter.

features.title: Safe Scatter
features.description: Three to five safes award 10–20 Free Spins and an instant prize according to the Scatter count.

features.title: Wanted Posters
features.description: An outlaw symbol matching its reel’s poster triggers expansion.

intro: 30 Coins Grand Gold Edition retains the thirty-position grid but improves Cluster Collector: modifiers can change how it accumulates values.
Collect to Infinity keeps the enhanced Collector active until the bonus round ends. Chance Level offers a choice of three stake increases, while the Grand Jackpot rises to 2500x.
wazdan-30-coins-grand-gold-edition.editorial: Gold differs from ordinary 30 Coins through enhanced Collectors and Collect to Infinity, as well as the increase in maximum win from 1500x to 2500x.

features.title: Cluster Collector modifiers
features.description: Special symbols enhance the collection of surrounding cash-symbol values.

features.title: Collect to Infinity
features.description: The modified Collector keeps working until the next bonus ends.

features.title: Chance Level and Jackpot 2500x
features.description: Three stake-adjustment levels are available, while the holding bonus’s Grand Jackpot reaches 2500x.

intro: In 4 Pots of Egypt, four pot meters fill with progress symbols and activate Hold & Win. During respins, a Mystery Symbol becomes one of four features.
Boost increases values, Collect gathers them, Multi applies a multiplier to every symbol, and Jackpot Feature adds jackpots to three random positions.
3-oaks-gaming-4-pots-of-egypt.editorial: 4 Pots of Egypt’s distinction is its four-pot set: when all meters are filled, Boost, Collect, Multi and Jackpot Feature activate together.

features.title: Four pots and Hold & Win
features.description: Four pot meters fill with progress symbols and trigger Hold & Win. Bonus coins can contain MINI, MINOR, MAXI, MAJOR or GRAND, while filling the grid awards the Royal Jackpot.

features.title: Four pot features
features.description: Boost increases every value, Collect gathers visible values, Multi applies a multiplier to all symbols, and Jackpot Feature adds MINI through MAJOR to three random symbols.

features.title: Mystery during respins
features.description: A Mystery Symbol turns into one of four features during the respin series. If all four meters are filled, every feature activates together.

intro: Three Bonus Token types are linked to Loyalty Bonus Spins, Honor Hold & Win Spins and Vengeance Jackpot Spins.
One spin can trigger between one and three bonuses, including combined double and triple Bonus rounds.
bgaming-the-godfather-3-pillars-of-power.editorial: The Godfather: 3 Pillars of Power revolves around three independent bonus directions: sticky Mystery Spins, Hold & Win with Collectors, and a separate Jackpot system.

features.title: Loyalty Bonus Spins
features.description: Bronze Bonus Tokens unlock Loyalty Spins. Mystery Symbols become sticky and can fill the reels, revealing new symbols on every spin.

features.title: Honor Hold & Win
features.description: Silver Tokens activate Hold & Win with Instant Win coins and Collector Symbols that gather visible Instant Win prizes and award extra spins.

features.title: Vengeance Jackpot Spins
features.description: Gold Tokens trigger Vengeance Jackpot Spins. All three bonus types can activate separately, in pairs or simultaneously in a triple Bonus.

intro: Book Symbol acts as both Wild and Scatter, while the base Book mechanic selects a random Special Symbol and can place 3–5 copies before expansion.
Book of Dawn selects one Special Symbol, while Triple Book of Dawn selects three; when Special Symbols land on at least three reels, they expand across their occupied reels and pay anywhere.
hacksaw-gaming-dawn-of-kings.editorial: Dawn of Kings takes the classic book setup and brings Special Symbol expansion into the base game, while Triple Book of Dawn increases variety with three selected symbols at once.

features.title: Book Symbol and base-game expansion
features.description: Book substitutes for ordinary symbols and acts as a Scatter for triggering the bonus. In the base game, a random Special Symbol can fill several reels and then form an anywhere payout.

features.title: Book of Dawn and Triple Book
features.description: Three Books trigger ten Free Spins with one selected Special Symbol. Four Books unlock twelve Triple Book of Dawn spins, where three different Special Symbols are selected.

features.title: Best of Bonus and extra spins
features.description: Best of Bonus together with the required Book count runs three complete bonus rounds of the selected version and keeps the highest result. During the ordinary bonus, new Books can add spins.

intro: Triple Berry Layer Cake acts as Wild. A stack of three matching high-paying desserts on the designated reel awards a treat token; each set of three matching tokens triggers one of five Flour Power features with extra Wilds, full Wild reels and other enhancements.

Bake-Off unlocks when each of the five highest-paying desserts has appeared on its correct reel at least once. The round plays all five Flour Power features in sequence, carrying the previous effect into the next spin; additional correct dessert stacks can extend the round to 10 spins.
playn-go-bakers-treat.editorial: Baker's Treat uses two accumulation layers rather than one bonus trigger: treat tokens individually unlock Flour Power, while a complete set of high-paying desserts brings those features together in a sequential Bake-Off.

features.title: Flour Power and Bake-Off
features.description: Dessert stacks award treat tokens and five different Flour Power features, while a complete set of high-paying desserts triggers Bake-Off with effects carried between spins.

features.title: Triple Berry Layer Cake Wild
features.description: Triple Berry Layer Cake substitutes for ordinary symbols as Wild; separate stacks of high-paying desserts matter to the accumulation mechanic.

features.title: Treat Tokens and Flour Power
features.description: Three matching treat tokens activate one of five Flour Power features. Tokens are awarded for three matching high-paying desserts on their corresponding reel.

features.title: Bake-Off with carried effects
features.description: Once all five high-paying desserts have appeared on their own reels, Bake-Off plays five Flour Power features in sequence; the previous effect carries into the next spin, and the round can extend to ten.

intro: Diamond Supernova 100 is a classic Reel Hot Games slot with 100 paylines. Three Star Scatters can appear only on reels 1, 3 and 5 and award a fixed prize for a matching colour.
Three blue Scatters pay x25, red pay x100, and gold pay x1000 the stake. A combination of different colours on those same reels pays separately at x5.
push-gaming-diamond-supernova-100.editorial: The 100 version differs from other Diamond Supernova games only in its verifiable hundred-payline configuration and its own published RTP values; the three-colour Scatter rules are shared across the series.

features.title: 100 paylines
features.description: Ordinary symbol combinations are calculated across a hundred paylines.

features.title: Three Star Scatter colours
features.description: Three matching Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 award x25, x100 or x1000.

features.title: Mixed Scatters
features.description: Any mixed set of three Scatters on the specified reels awards x5 the stake.

intro: 36 Coins expands the series onto a square 6×6 grid: its 36 separate positions can fill with cash symbols in Hold the Jackpot.
Cluster Collector uses neighbouring cells on the large grid, while Cash Infinity and Sticky to Infinity allow Cash, Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols to carry into the next bonus.
wazdan-36-coins.editorial: 36 Coins’ key step beyond 30 Coins is its 6×6 size and the new scale of Cluster Collector. The base version does not inherit Grand Gold’s Collect to Infinity modifier.

features.title: 6×6 grid
features.description: Thirty-six separate reels expand the number of Hold the Jackpot positions.

features.title: Cluster Collector
features.description: Collects neighbouring Cash Symbol values across a grid of 36 positions.

features.title: Cash Infinity and Sticky to Infinity
features.description: Some cash and Mystery Symbols persist until the next bonus with a Grand Jackpot of up to 2000x.

intro: In 4 Wolf Drums, three wolf drum meters fill with bonus symbols and trigger Hold & Win. Master Drum can intervene in the respin series.
Collect gathers values, Multi places multipliers, and Mirror opens two rows and can duplicate symbols between them.
3-oaks-gaming-4-wolf-drums.editorial: 4 Wolf Drums’ key variable is Master Drum: it can add bonus or jackpot symbols, reset respins or activate a missing feature.

features.title: Three wolf drums
features.description: Green, blue and red meters fill with bonus symbols and trigger Hold & Win. MINI, MINOR, MAJOR and GRAND are available in the bonus; filling the grid also awards the Grand Jackpot.

features.title: Collect, Multi and Mirror
features.description: Collect gathers values, Multi adds multipliers to empty cells and increases them by +1 on a repeat landing. Mirror opens two rows and can duplicate a symbol between them.

features.title: Master Drum
features.description: Master Drum can activate at any point in the bonus: adding bonus or jackpot symbols to empty cells, resetting respins or activating an inactive feature.

intro: Winning clusters turn into highlighted cells where Coin Multipliers, Boosters and Collect Coin Symbols work.
Three Free Spins types use these highlighted cells differently, while Mega Free Spins adds TNT on every spin and removes Bronze Coins.
bgaming-train-heist-johnny-cash.editorial: Train Heist Johnny Cash develops Cluster Pays through a Coin Modifier system: winning cells become persistent locations for coin effects, while three Free Spins modes progressively enhance the mechanic.

features.title: Highlighted cells and three Free Spins modes
features.description: Coin Respins create highlighted cells where Multipliers, Boosters and Collect Coins appear; Free Spins retain and enhance these cells.

features.title: Coin Boosters and Collect Coins
features.description: Highlighted cells can reveal Coin Boosters of x2–x10 for neighbouring coins or Collect Coins that gather all Coin Symbols on the grid and clear their positions for new landings.

features.title: Three Free Spins modes
features.description: Three Scatters award eight Free Spins; four award twelve Super Free Spins with persistent highlighted cells; five award twelve Mega Free Spins with TNT on every spin and no Bronze Coins.

intro: JOKER Symbols switch the game from Classic Mode into Poker Mode: paying symbols become cards, and each row automatically forms the best possible five-card hand.
Joker can become the best card for its row, add a Hand Multiplier or Global Multiplier, while Triple Trouble reshuffles cards after wins to form the three best hands.
hacksaw-gaming-deal-with-death.editorial: Deal With Death literally switches its mechanic from slot to poker within one spin: a row’s value depends on its Poker Hand, while different Joker modifiers change both cards and multipliers.

features.title: Classic Mode turns into Poker Mode
features.description: JOKER switches the ordinary payline grid into a poker round: paying symbols become cards, and each horizontal row forms the best possible five-card hand.

features.title: Different Joker roles
features.description: An ordinary Joker replaces a card with the most favourable one for the row, Hand Multiplier Joker boosts a specific hand, Global Multiplier Joker boosts all wins, and Triple Trouble reshuffles cards for three new hands.

features.title: Deal With It, Dealbreaker and Fool’s Gold
features.description: Three FS symbols award ten Deal With It spins with a higher Joker chance; four trigger Dealbreaker with a growing Poker Hand paytable; five unlock Fool’s Gold with a guaranteed Joker on every spin.

intro: Two or more Rock ’n’ Rollin’ Wilds trigger a re-spin: Wilds stay, while the rightmost moves towards the leftmost, travelling vertically and horizontally and leaving a Wild trail.

Two Scatters on reels 1 and 5 award 10 Free Spins. Stacked band members charge individual multipliers from x2 to x5; after the bonus, Encore Spin guarantees a win using only band-member symbols and applies the accumulated multiplier total, up to x25.
playn-go-banana-rock.editorial: Banana Rock links moving Wilds with a separate concert progression: one Wild traces a Wild path during the re-spin, while Free Spins gradually boost each band member before the final Encore Spin.

features.title: Rock ’n’ Rollin’ Re-Spins and Encore Spin
features.description: Multiple Wilds trigger a moving-Wild re-spin, Free Spins charge band-member multipliers, and Encore Spin uses their combined multiplier.

features.title: Rock ’n’ Rollin’ Wild Re-Spins
features.description: Two or more special Wilds trigger a series: the right Wild moves vertically and horizontally towards the left Wild, leaving a Wild trail.

features.title: Ten Free Spins series
features.description: Two Scatters on reels 1 and 5 unlock ten Free Spins, where band-member stacks gradually charge individual x2–x5 multipliers.

features.title: Encore Spin with a combined total
features.description: After the bonus series, Encore Spin guarantees a payout using only band-member symbols and applies the accumulated multiplier total, up to x25.

intro: Diamond Supernova 20 uses 20 paylines rather than repeating the 100 version’s setup. Star Scatters are restricted to reels 1, 3 and 5 but can have three different colours.
Three blue stars award x25, red award x100, and gold award x1000; a mixed set of three awards x5. The Scatter prize is separate from ordinary payline wins.
push-gaming-diamond-supernova-20.editorial: Diamond Supernova 20 differs from 5, 40 and 100 through twenty paylines and its own set of reference RTP values, rather than extra Free Spins, which the provider does not describe.

features.title: 20 paylines
features.description: The game fixes twenty paylines for ordinary combinations.

features.title: Matching Star Scatters
features.description: Blue, red and gold sets of three pay x25, x100 and x1000.

features.title: Multicoloured stars
features.description: Three differently coloured Stars on reels 1, 3, 5 pay x5 the stake.

intro: 36 Coins Grand Gold Edition uses a 6×6 grid but gives Cluster Collector the indefinite Collect to Infinity modifier for the first time in this branch.
The modified Collector stays active until the next bonus ends, while Chance Level offers three levels: x2, x5 and x10. Hold the Jackpot’s Grand Jackpot is at most 2500x the stake.
wazdan-36-coins-grand-gold-edition.editorial: Grand Gold’s main difference from ordinary 36 Coins is retaining Collector through Collect to Infinity and the Chance Level x2/x5/x10 settings.

features.title: Collect to Infinity
features.description: The enhanced Cluster Collector receives an unlimited timer until the bonus series ends.

features.title: Chance Level x2/x5/x10
features.description: Three higher-stake modes change the chance of starting Hold the Jackpot.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot 2500x
features.description: The 36-position grid can award a Grand Jackpot of up to 2500x the stake.

intro: In 777 Fruity Coins, Collect with 777 appears only on the middle reel and gathers all visible coin values. It is also needed to trigger the respin series.
Only coins, up to three Collect symbols and empty positions remain in the bonus. Each new symbol resets the three-respin counter.
3-oaks-gaming-777-fruity-coins.editorial: In 777 Fruity Coins, the combination of a central Collect and coins on the edges matters: three Collect symbols together with Grand can triple the Grand Jackpot to 3,000x the stake.

features.title: Collect only on the middle reel
features.description: The Collect coin with 777 appears only on the middle reel and immediately gathers the values of all visible bonus coins.

features.title: Three respins on fresh reels
features.description: The bonus triggers with bonus symbols on the first and third reels and a central Collect. Respins feature only bonus coins, up to three Collect symbols and empty positions; each new symbol resets the counter.

features.title: Three Collect symbols and Grand
features.description: Collect symbols lock and gather surrounding values. Special coins carry MINI, MINOR, MAJOR or GRAND; three Collect symbols together with Grand can triple the Grand Jackpot to 3,000x the stake.

intro: Three Scatters trigger Free Spins, and Wheel of Fortune determines their initial count before the bonus.
Wilds become sticky in Free Spins; every three collected Wilds add spins and increase all Wild multipliers.
bgaming-wincent-wolf.editorial: Wincent Wolf builds its bonus around Sticky Wilds and a Retrigger Counter: the Wheel sets the starting length, while accumulating Wilds extends the round and boosts multipliers at the same time.

features.title: Wheel of Fortune and Sticky Wilds
features.description: The Wheel determines the starting Free Spins, while Sticky Wilds fill the Retrigger Counter and increase their multipliers on retriggers.

features.title: Wild multipliers in the base game
features.description: Wild Symbols on reels 2, 3 and 4 substitute for any symbol except Scatter and carry x2 or x3 multipliers. In Free Spins, these Wilds lock until the bonus ends.

features.title: Retrigger Counter and Wild growth
features.description: Each Sticky Wild increases the Retrigger Counter. Three collected Wilds award another three Free Spins and double all Wild multipliers; this can retrigger up to three times.

intro: A VS Symbol contributing to a win expands into a full-reel Wild DuelReel and triggers a duel; the winning multiplier applies to all wins involving that reel.
If low-paying Symbols spell DEATH, Duel With Death triggers: the central reels become a Death DuelReel with three lives, and won multipliers accumulate for the next duel.
hacksaw-gaming-death-becomes-you.editorial: Death Becomes You makes DuelReels part of ordinary payouts, while a separate DEATH trigger turns the mechanic into a series of fights with a life reserve and a growing multiplier.

features.title: DuelReels and Duel With Death
features.description: VS expands into a Wild DuelReel, while the word DEATH triggers a multi-step duel where winning multipliers carry into the next fight.

features.title: DuelReels: Wild multipliers
features.description: A winning VS Symbol expands into a full-reel Wild and triggers a Duel. The winning multiplier from x2 to x100 applies to all wins involving the resulting DuelReel.

features.title: Three bonuses: Maker, Drop Dead, Epic
features.description: Three FS symbols unlock Meet Your Maker for 10 spins; four FS symbols unlock Drop Dead with three lives; five FS symbols unlock Epic Death with five lives and Duel With Death on the very first spin.

intro: Three, four or five Scatters trigger 9, 12 or 15 Reward Spins. Before they begin, Modifier Wheel selects Win Multiplier, Banana Upgrade or Basket Boost; Banana Baskets during the round can add spins and strengthen modifiers.

If Bananas land without a Basket, Gorilla collects them. Hold & Win can trigger after this collection: only Banana symbols remain, each new Banana resets respins, and filling the entire grid awards an additional special prize.
playn-go-banana-rush.editorial: Banana Rush separates bonus play into two paths: Modifier Wheel and Banana Baskets control Reward Spins, while Gorilla Collect can unexpectedly move a spin into a separate Hold & Win with sticky banana values.

features.title: Reward Spins, Modifier Wheel and Gorilla Hold & Win
features.description: Scatters unlock Reward Spins with one of three modifiers, Banana Baskets extend the round, and Gorilla Collect can trigger Banana-only Hold & Win.

features.title: Reward Spins from Scatters
features.description: Three, four and five Scatters trigger 9, 12 and 15 Reward Spins respectively; Modifier Wheel determines the enhancement type before they start.

features.title: Modifier Wheel and Banana Baskets
features.description: The wheel selects Win Multiplier, Banana Upgrade or Basket Boost. Banana Baskets can add spins and improve the active enhancement.

features.title: Gorilla Collect and Banana Hold & Win
features.description: If Bananas land without a Basket, Gorilla can collect them and move the game into Hold & Win, where new Banana Symbols reset the respin count and filling the grid awards a special prize.

intro: Diamond Supernova 40 offers 40 paylines. As in other Reel Hot Games titles in this series, Star Scatters appear only on the first, third and fifth reels.
Three matching Stars award between x25 and x1000 the stake depending on their colour, while mixed colours on the three Scatter reels pay x5.
push-gaming-diamond-supernova-40.editorial: Extra bonuses from other versions should not be invented for Diamond Supernova 40: its verified distinctions are forty paylines and a two-tier Scatter prize system.

features.title: 40 paylines
features.description: Ordinary combinations are evaluated on forty paylines.

features.title: Star Scatter x25–x1000
features.description: Three of one colour unlock the corresponding fixed stake multiplier.

features.title: Mixed set of three
features.description: Differently coloured Star Scatters pay x5 in positions 1, 3 and 5.

intro: 9 Balls turns the nine-position Coins system into a football scenario: Penalty Kick offers a chance to receive a cash reward in the base mode.

A symbol with a Penalty Kick label holds a countdown to zero, then collects the prize. Cash Infinity remains until the bonus, while xG Chance Level increases the chance of triggering Hold the Jackpot.
wazdan-9-balls.editorial: Unlike 9 Bells, this has no bell-based Bonus Matrix: 9 Balls uses a football Penalty Kick label, its own xG Chance Level and a Grand Jackpot of up to 2500x.

features.title: Penalty Kick
features.description: A special label has a countdown; at zero, it pays accumulated values in the base game.

features.title: xG Chance Level
features.description: Increasing the stake changes the probability of entering the football Hold the Jackpot.

features.title: Cash Infinity
features.description: Cash symbols can persist until the bonus series ends; the verified maximum for 9 Balls is 2500x.

intro: In 777 Gems Respin, two reels filled with matching Gems on a non-winning spin lock, while the third receives a respin.
A full screen of matching Gems applies x2 to that win. Base payouts use five paylines with three matching symbols.
3-oaks-gaming-777-gems-respin.editorial: 777 Gems Respin’s main condition is a pair of reels filled with matching symbols: it provides another chance to collect the third and complete the screen with the same symbol.

features.title: Respin from two filled reels
features.description: If two reels are filled with matching gem symbols on a non-winning spin, they lock and the third reel receives a respin.

features.title: Full-screen Gems x2
features.description: A full screen of matching Gems activates a x2 multiplier for that win.

features.title: Five paylines with different payouts
features.description: Three matching symbols on any of five paylines form a win: red sevens pay 150x the stake, bells 50x, Bars 10x, Gems 5x and X 1x.

intro: Blue and Red Wilds help form combinations, with Red Wilds carrying values that add to the Moon Multiplier.
Before Free Spins, the samurai reveals numbers on moons to determine the spin count; Wilds become sticky in the bonus, and the Moon Multiplier accumulates.
bgaming-yokai.editorial: Yokai links Sticky Wilds to an accumulating Moon Multiplier: Wild values add together each spin, while the overall multiplier continues growing throughout the Free Spins round.

features.title: Sticky Wilds and Moon Multiplier
features.description: Red Wilds add values to the Moon Multiplier; in Free Spins, all Wilds become sticky and the multiplier does not reset between spins.

features.title: The samurai selects bonus duration
features.description: Before Free Spins, the samurai reveals nine moons with numbers 1, 2 or 3; their sum determines the spin count. Two Scatters in the bonus reveal another six moons for extra spins.

features.title: Red Wilds and Scatters
features.description: Red Wilds on reels 2–4 carry +2, +3, +5 or +10. Three Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger Free Spins; within the bonus, Scatters are available only on 1 and 5.

intro: Densho Symbols expand into Wild Multiplier Reels if they cross a winning payline after expansion; Common, Rare and Legendary variants carry different multiplier ranges.
In Free Spins, a Progression Tracker operates above each reel: an Upgrade Symbol raises its level and therefore the minimum quality of Densho Symbol that can land on that reel.
hacksaw-gaming-densho.editorial: Densho links expanding Wild quality to the progress of a particular reel: the bonus does more than increase feature frequency, gradually raising the minimum strength of Densho Symbols.

features.title: Three Densho Wild Reel levels
features.description: Densho expands into a full Wild reel when it crosses a winning payline after expansion. Common, Rare and Legendary differ in multiplier ranges; multiple Wild Reel values in one payout add together.

features.title: Progression Trackers in Free Spins
features.description: Each reel has its own Progression Tracker above it in the bonus. A landed Upgrade raises its level and the minimum Densho category that can appear on that reel.

features.title: Super Free Spins with an enhanced start
features.description: Super Free Spins starts Progression Trackers at the second level: Densho cannot be below Rare on any reel. Two or three new FS symbols during the bonus add spins.

intro: In Free Spins, a random ordinary paying symbol becomes the Special Expanding Symbol. After ordinary combinations pay, it can expand across its entire reel if enough instances are present on the grid.

Each Expansion activation removes the lowest-paying symbol from the reel set before the next spin. This continues with new expansions, and a new Special Symbol is selected if the current one is removed. The bonus starts with 7 Free Spins; new Scatters add 3 spins at a time, up to 25 rounds.
playn-go-banquet-of-dead.editorial: Banquet of Dead makes its expanding-symbol mechanic progressive: each expansion creates the current win and simplifies the future symbol set by removing the lowest-paying symbol from the reels.

features.title: Expanding Symbol and Symbol Removal
features.description: Free Spins select a Special Expanding Symbol, expansions remove the lowest-paying symbols before subsequent spins, and Scatter retriggers extend the bonus.

features.title: Special Expanding Symbol
features.description: An ordinary paying symbol is selected at the start of Free Spins; after standard wins, it can expand across its reel if enough of it is present on the grid.

features.title: Removing the lowest-paying symbol
features.description: Each successful Expansion removes the lowest-paying symbol from the set before the next spin; if the Special Symbol itself is removed, a new one is selected.

features.title: Seven Free Spins and extensions
features.description: The bonus starts with seven spins. New Scatters add three at a time, but the spin count is capped at 25.

intro: Diamond Supernova 5 uses only five paylines while retaining the recognisable high-paying Diamond Symbols. Three Star Scatters are available exclusively on reels 1, 3 and 5.
Three blue Stars award x25, red award x100, and gold award x1000; if the three have mixed colours, x5 the stake is paid.
push-gaming-diamond-supernova-5.editorial: Of the four Diamond Supernova games, this version has the fewest paylines: five. Matching symbols do not justify describing it as a 20- or 100-payline slot.

features.title: Five paylines
features.description: Diamond Supernova 5’s verified configuration is five paylines.

features.title: Same-colour Scatters
features.description: Three blue, red or gold Stars award x25, x100 or x1000.

features.title: Mixed Scatter Prize
features.description: Different Scatter colours on the first, third and fifth reels award x5.

intro: 9 Bells combines Cash Out and Bonus Matrix on nine separate reels. Bell symbols fill the bonus matrix, creating a second route to Hold the Jackpot.
Cash Infinity increases future cash values, while Chance Level has three steps that can raise the probability of entering the bonus by up to six times. The stated Grand Jackpot is 1500x the stake.
wazdan-9-bells.editorial: 9 Bells should be distinguished from 12 Bells: this has Bonus Matrix and Cash Out, rather than a separate mode for choosing three of twelve gates.

features.title: Bonus Matrix
features.description: Bell Symbols advance the bonus matrix and can activate Hold the Jackpot.

features.title: Cash Out
features.description: A separate feature pays accumulated cash values in the base game.

features.title: Chance Level and Grand Jackpot
features.description: Three modes increase bonus chances by up to six times, with a Grand Jackpot of up to 1500x.

intro: In Amazonia Wins, an Extra Board above the central reels holds cash prizes and jackpots. These cells do not contribute to paylines on their own.
Win on the first or fifth reel together with Collect takes the prize above the corresponding position. Golden Idol unlocks five bonus spins.
3-oaks-gaming-amazonia-wins.editorial: In Amazonia Wins, watch the Win and Collect combination: three Collect symbols can take all three prizes, while two Win symbols double each one.

features.title: Prizes on the Extra Board
features.description: Above reels 2, 3 and 4 sits an Extra Board with cash prizes, MINI, MINOR, MAJOR, GRAND, Mystery and Mystery Jackpot. They do not contribute to paylines on their own.

features.title: Win + Collect take the reward
features.description: Win on the first or fifth reel together with Collect on one of the three central reels takes the prize above that Collect. Three Collect symbols can take all three prizes, while two Win symbols double each prize.

features.title: Five idol bonus spins
features.description: Golden Idol fills with Bonus and Super Bonus from the Extra Board and triggers five bonus spins. Only Win and Collect appear in them, with Win multipliers of x1–x2 or x2–x5 in Super Bonus.
