intro: A Wild Multiplier can have up to three Vitality units: while any remain, the symbol is Sticky and triggers a respin, losing one unit after each respin.
Aphrodite’s Love restores Vitality to all Wild Multipliers, Zeus’s Thunder doubles their values, and FS Symbols can accumulate in the Bonus Meter during respins.
hacksaw-gaming-divine-drop.editorial: Divine Drop builds sequences around the Vitality resource: a Wild multiplier holds its position only while it has hearts, while Aphrodite and Zeus extend or strengthen that positional value in different ways.

features.title: Wild Multiplier with Vitality reserves
features.description: Wild Multiplier substitutes for paying symbols and can land with three Vitality hearts. Until the resource runs out, Wild remains Sticky and triggers respins, losing a heart with each subsequent respin.

features.title: Aphrodite’s Love and Zeus’s Thunder
features.description: Heart triggers Aphrodite’s Love and restores between one and three hearts to all Wild Multipliers. An X symbol triggers Zeus’s Thunder, doubling all Wild multipliers on the grid.

features.title: FS Collect and two Tricks of Hades
features.description: During respins, individual FS symbols can accumulate in the Bonus Meter while an active Wild is present. Three FS symbols trigger Tricks of Hades; four trigger Triple Tricks, where Wild Multipliers land with a minimum of 3x.

intro: Lioras Blessings can activate randomly in ordinary play and turn symbols into Coin Wilds with multipliers. Several such Wilds can contribute to one win at the same time.
Three, four or five Gong Scatters trigger 8, 12 or 15 Free Spins respectively. The bonus uses upgraded Lioras symbols and extra Coin Wild multipliers, strengthening the same Blessings mechanic.
playn-go-bao-shi.editorial: Bao Shi does not split its base and bonus mechanics into separate systems: Lioras Blessings remains the central idea, while Free Spins increase its frequency and the strength of Coin Wild multipliers.

features.title: Lioras Blessings and Gong Free Spins
features.description: Blessings turn symbols into Coin Wilds with multipliers, while 3–5 Gongs award 8–15 Free Spins with enhanced Lioras symbols and extra Coin Wilds.

features.title: Random Lioras Blessings
features.description: On a base spin, Blessings can turn ordinary symbols into Coin Wilds with multipliers; several such Wilds can contribute to one win.

features.title: Gong Scatter and spin count
features.description: Three, four and five Gong Scatters award 8, 12 and 15 Free Spins respectively.

features.title: Enhanced Lioras in the bonus
features.description: Free Spins use upgraded Lioras symbols and extra Coin Wild multipliers: this is an enhanced version of the main system rather than a completely different bonus.

intro: Diamonds 4 The Win is a three-reel slot with five paylines. A central Diamond Wild activates Diamond Respin, which continues while at least one new Wild Diamond appears on the next spin.
Opening the Vault triggers Super Diamond Respin with a guaranteed central Diamond Wild and a x2, x3, x5 or x10 multiplier for combinations involving it.
push-gaming-diamonds-4-the-win.editorial: Diamonds 4 The Win’s main difference from Diamond Supernova is respins around a central Wild Diamond and a separate Vault, rather than Scatter stars.

features.title: Diamond Respin
features.description: A Wild Diamond in the central position triggers a series extended by each new Wild.

features.title: Vault
features.description: The vault takes the game into an enhanced respin with a central Diamond already added.

features.title: Super Respin multiplier
features.description: The central Diamond in the enhanced mode can receive x2, x3, x5 or x10.

intro: 9 Burning Dragons uses nine separate reels and a straightforward Hold the Jackpot, accessible through ordinary play or Buy Feature.
Unlike newer Coins versions, this has no long chain of Cash Infinity, Cash Out and Cluster Collector: its key features are direct access to Hold the Jackpot and themed Wild Symbols.
wazdan-9-burning-dragons.editorial: 9 Burning Dragons is best compared through its compact structure rather than its number of extras: nine positions, Wild and a bonus buy with a verified maximum of 2187x the stake.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot
features.description: The main nine-reel bonus is linked to cash prizes and a stated limit of 2187x the stake.

features.title: Buy Feature
features.description: An optional feature provides direct entry to the bonus round.

features.title: Wild and gamble game
features.description: Wild substitutes for ordinary symbols, while an additional Gamble Feature is separate from Hold the Jackpot.

intro: In Aztec Fire, six fiery meteors carrying cash values trigger Hold & Win. Each new sticky symbol resets the three-respin counter.
Collecting bonus symbols progressively opens up to four extra rows. A separate free-spins mode uses only high-paying symbols.
3-oaks-gaming-aztec-fire.editorial: In Aztec Fire, Hold & Win progression is linked to grid size: expansion to 40 positions opens a route to the Royal Jackpot of 10,000x the stake.

features.title: Six meteors for Hold & Win
features.description: Six fiery meteors carrying cash values trigger Hold & Win. The bonus starts with three respins, and each new sticky symbol resets the counter.

features.title: Expansion to 40 positions
features.description: Collecting bonus symbols opens up to four extra rows. Filling all 40 positions on the expanded grid can award the Royal Jackpot of 10,000x the stake.

features.title: Free spins with only high-paying symbols
features.description: Only high-paying symbols appear in free spins, and extra free spins can retrigger.

intro: A LootLine forms when a winning payline contains at least three Donny Symbols or a mix of Donny and Danny; each Donny takes a random Cash Board value, and these values form the line payout.
After ordinary payouts, Danny Symbols expand upwards into Dollar-Reels and reveal a multiplier at each covered position; Booster Symbol removes the lowest Cash Board value in the bonuses.
hacksaw-gaming-donny-and-danny.editorial: Donny and Danny combines the brothers’ two signature mechanics: Donny turns a payline into selections from the Cash Board, while Danny expands Dollar-Reels and adds positional multipliers.

features.title: Donny’s LootLines and Cash Board
features.description: A winning LootLine consists of at least three Donny symbols or a Donny and Danny combination. Each Donny selects a Cash Board value, and the line payout is calculated from the resulting values.

features.title: Danny’s Dollar-Reels
features.description: After ordinary wins are calculated, Danny expands upwards to the top of the grid and forms a Dollar-Reel. Each occupied position reveals a multiplier and can contribute to a LootLine.

features.title: Booster changes the Cash Board in the bonus
features.description: In Make It Reign and Cash Kings Forever, a Booster landing removes the lowest Cash Board value. This changes the available prize-value set without turning Dollar-Reels into ordinary Wild reels.

intro: One or two Big Bell Scatters can trigger Double Wheel: the first wheel awards an Instant Prize, a Sheep feature or an Upgrade to the second wheel. A Sheep feature awards 6 re-spins where Scatters turn into Hay, Wood or Gold Frames belonging to that sheep.

Three or more Big Bell Scatters trigger 6 Barn Spins. Frames upgrade from Hay to Wood to Gold, then become barns with multiplier prizes at the end. A fully golden grid and a new Scatter immediately pay x100; new 3+ Scatters can retrigger Barn Spins up to a total cap of 80.
playn-go-barn-busters.editorial: Barn Busters builds both bonus branches around one Frame system: short Sheep re-spins specialise in one Frame type, while Barn Spins gradually upgrade the entire grid before converting it into multiplier barns.

features.title: Double Wheel, Sheep Features and Barn Spins
features.description: Big Bell Scatters trigger the Wheel or Barn Spins; Frames grow from Hay to Gold and become barns with multiplier prizes at the bonus’s end.

features.title: Double Wheel from Big Bell
features.description: One or two Big Bell Scatters can trigger a wheel with an Instant Prize, Sheep Feature or an Upgrade to a second wheel offering more reward options.

features.title: Cashmere, Woollyhammer, Banksie
features.description: Six Sheep Re-Spins turn Scatters into a specific Frame type: Hay, Wood or Gold; Frames upgrade when the grid fills.

features.title: Barn Spins and Frames Into Barns
features.description: Three or more Big Bells trigger six Barn Spins, with repeat Scatters extending the series up to 80. Hay/Wood/Gold Frames become barns with multiplier prizes at the end.

intro: Dino P.D. gives Dino Coins a separate rule: any five coins on screen award a prize, with values displayed directly on the symbols. Wild substitutes for ordinary symbols but not Coins or Scatters.

Scatters on reels 1 and 3 together with a Gamble Scatter on the fifth unlock a Bronze, Silver or Gold Free Spins choice. Four Dino Coin Collectors during the bonus advance the Low Symbol replacement meter and add spins.
push-gaming-dino-p-d.editorial: Dino P.D. does not repeat Dinopolis: two Scatters and a Gamble Scatter trigger the bonus on specific reels, while Coin Collectors accumulate to upgrade low-paying symbols.

features.title: Five Dino Coins
features.description: Five coins of any denomination together award a separate payout.

features.title: Gamble Scatter
features.description: The symbol on the fifth reel together with Scatters on the first and third unlocks Free Spins options.

features.title: Four Collectors
features.description: Collecting four Collectors upgrades one Low Symbol and boosts the multiplier.

intro: 9 Burning Stars triggers Hold the Jackpot through Bonus Matrix: cash Symbols gradually fill a separate matrix until the bonus activates.
A Multiplier Symbol boosts the overall payout by x2, x3, x5, x7 or x10, while Bonus Collector can change cash values within the bonus scenario.
wazdan-9-burning-stars.editorial: This is more than a space-themed 9 Burning Dragons. In 9 Burning Stars, Bonus Matrix drives the bonus trigger, and multipliers apply to the overall win rather than only a payline.

features.title: Bonus Matrix
features.description: Cash Symbols fill a progress table, triggering Hold the Jackpot once it is full.

features.title: Multiplier x2–x10
features.description: A separate symbol increases the final payout by x2, x3, x5, x7 or x10.

features.title: Bonus Collector
features.description: Enhances cash collection in Hold the Jackpot; this version’s Grand Jackpot is 1500x the stake.

intro: In Aztec Fire 2, six meteors trigger Hold & Win with three respins. As 10, 15, 20 and 25 bonus symbols are collected, the grid opens four more rows.
Each filled extra row awards a multiplier of up to x10 for its symbols. Five fixed jackpots are available in the bonus.
3-oaks-gaming-aztec-fire-2.editorial: In Aztec Fire 2, the expansion sequence matters: additional rows do more than enlarge the grid to eight rows, as they introduce multipliers for their symbols.

features.title: Eight rows in Hold & Win
features.description: Six meteors trigger Hold & Win with three respins. After 10, 15, 20 and 25 bonus symbols, the fifth, sixth, seventh and eighth rows open.

features.title: Multipliers in extra rows
features.description: Each filled extra row unlocks a multiplier of up to x10 for that row’s symbols. Filling all eight rows awards the Royal Jackpot of 10,000x the stake.

features.title: Five fixed jackpots
features.description: The bonus offers MINI 10x, MIDI 20x, MINOR 40x, MAJOR 100x and GRAND 1,000x the stake. A separate bonus-symbol meter can also trigger Hold & Win.

intro: LootLines™ consist of Multi-Dough Symbols: their adding and multiplying values apply from left to right, so symbol order affects the line’s final multiplier.

In Sticky Dough, Multi-Dough symbols stay in place until contributing to a winning line. In Strike Gold, winning positions light indicators; Donny’s Hat then triggers a respin with new Multi-Dough symbols on the marked reels.
hacksaw-gaming-donny-dough.editorial: Donny Dough turns a payline into a small arithmetic expression: Multi-Dough symbols add and multiply in order, while the two bonuses either hold them until a win or use winning positions for the next respin.

features.title: LootLines with ordered addition and multiplication
features.description: Multi-Dough symbols appear as adding and multiplying values, including hidden Revealing variants. They apply left to right in a LootLine: changing symbol order can change the final payout.

features.title: Sticky Dough retains Multi-Dough
features.description: Three FS symbols trigger ten Sticky Dough spins. Multi-Dough symbols remain in their positions until contributing to a winning payline; after that win, they are removed on the next spin.

features.title: Strike Gold, lights and Donny’s Hat
features.description: Four FS symbols unlock Strike Gold: winning Multi-Dough symbols light indicators above the reels. Donny’s Hat triggers a respin and adds Multi-Dough symbols on marked reels; Hat is guaranteed at the end of the bonus.

intro: Random Wilds can add 3–6 Wild symbols on reels 2–4. Separately, one of those reels can become a Wild Reel and fill entirely with Wilds.
Scatters on reels 1 and 5 trigger Free Spins with 8 spins at Stage 1. Collecting new Scatters raises the Stage: the Wild multiplier grows through x2, x3, x5 and x10 while adding extra Free Spins.
playn-go-baron-lord-of-saturday.editorial: Baron: Lord of Saturday uses the central reels as its main enhancement area: they receive Random Wilds and a full Wild Reel in the base game, while the bonus links that same Wild mechanic to four-stage multiplier growth.

features.title: Random Wilds, Wild Reels and Staged Free Spins
features.description: Reels 2–4 receive random Wilds or a full Wild Reel, while Scatters raise the Free Spins Stage and Wild multiplier up to x10.

features.title: Random Wilds on the central reels
features.description: A random activation adds between three and six Wilds to reels 2–4.

features.title: Full Wild Reel
features.description: A second independent effect can fill one of the three central reels entirely with Wild Symbols.

features.title: Four Free Spins stages
features.description: Scatters on the outer reels activate an eight-spin bonus; new Scatters advance the Stage, raising the Wild multiplier through x2 → x3 → x5 → x10 and adding spins.

intro: Dinopolis uses a 3-4-4-4-3 reel layout. Dino Coins appear only on the first and fifth reels, while Wild Multipliers occupy the central area.
Three Scatters on reels 2, 3 and 4 unlock Dino Bonus with two card choices: enhancement type and Free Spins count. Five Dino Collector Coins move the game to the next of five levels.
push-gaming-dinopolis.editorial: Dinopolis builds a long bonus progression through levels and Sticky Stack Wilds rather than Dino P.D.’s police Collector mechanics. A Wild stack here can stay for the entire bonus.

features.title: 3-4-4-4-3 grid
features.description: The outer reels are shorter than the central reels, while Dino Coins are restricted to the first and fifth.

features.title: Card Pick
features.description: After three Scatters, cards determine the bonus feature and starting spin count.

features.title: Five levels
features.description: Five Collector Coins unlock the next level; Sticky Stack Wilds can remain and strengthen.

intro: 9 Coins centres on nine independent positions rather than ordinary paying lines: the base game does not pay wins. The result collects in Hold the Jackpot, where coins and special symbols lock on the grid.
Cash Infinity can appear before the bonus and remain in place; landing on the middle row increases the trigger chance. Filling all nine positions awards the Grand Jackpot of 500x the stake.
wazdan-9-coins.editorial: The original 9 Coins has an unusual setup without base-game payouts. Comparisons with sequels should not attribute the later Chance Level and Cash Out features to it.

features.title: Nine positions without base payouts
features.description: Ordinary play has no payline cash combinations: collection occurs through a nine-position bonus round.

features.title: Hold the Jackpot
features.description: Cash Infinity stays on the grid; Collector totals coin values and applies a multiplier from x1 to x9.

features.title: Mystery and Grand Jackpot
features.description: Mystery reveals another bonus symbol, Jackpot Mystery awards one of three jackpots, and filling all nine positions awards 500x.

intro: In Aztec Sun, six fiery suns trigger Hold & Win with three respins.
Each new sun resets the counter to three.
3-oaks-gaming-aztec-sun.editorial: A separate mode with three Scatters awards eight free spins using only high-paying symbols.

features.title: Hold & Win
features.description: Suns can contain MINI and MAJOR Jackpots.

features.title: Grand Jackpot
features.description: All 15 positions can award Grand Jackpot x1,000.

features.title: Free spins
features.description: Three Scatters trigger eight free spins with possible retriggers.

intro: When Gooey Gun lands, it fires Gooey Wilds to the left along its row and becomes Wild itself; if the Gun has a multiplier, every Gooey Wild it creates receives that value.

Warehouse replaces ordinary payouts with two flashlight positions: they reveal hidden symbols, accumulate adding/multiplying multipliers in a Total Multiplier, and can expand through Battery or reveal the entire grid through Light-Switch.
hacksaw-gaming-donut-division.editorial: Donut Division combines two different approaches: Gooey Guns spread multipliers along rows in the base game, while Warehouse turns the bonus into a search for special symbols with a limited number of illuminated positions.

features.title: Gooey Guns spread Wilds along a row
features.description: Gooey Gun fires Gooey Wilds left to the edge of the grid and becomes Wild itself. All symbols created by one shot inherit the Gun’s multiplier, while connected values in the row add together.

features.title: Warehouse: two flashlights and three lives
features.description: Warehouse hides multipliers, Battery and Light-Switch instead of ordinary symbols. Two flashlights reveal cells in turn; special finds restore lives, while multipliers accumulate in the Total Multiplier.

features.title: Bonus Choice and enhanced versions
features.description: Three FS symbols offer a choice between Warehouse and Stakeout; four offer their Super variants. Super Warehouse raises the minimum adding-multiplier level, while the choice changes bonus rules rather than the main Gooey Gun mechanic.

intro: King Henry acts as Wild. Scatter coats of arms on reels 1 and 5 unlock Free Spins, where the player chooses one of six Royal Wives.

During Free Spins, the guillotine removes wives in turn; an eliminated wife becomes Wild until the bonus ends. The last remaining wife can be placed on a chosen reel: a successful execution triggers Long Live the King, where treasure chests must be opened, ghost wives avoided, and a key found for a win multiplier.
playn-go-battle-royal.editorial: Battle Royal turns Free Spins into a gradual reduction of its character set: every eliminated wife increases Wild density, while the final surviving wife determines the chance of entering a separate chest-pick round.

features.title: Royal Wives and Long Live the King
features.description: Free Spins turn eliminated wives into Wilds, while the final execution can unlock a pick feature with treasure chests, a key and a win multiplier.

features.title: King Henry Wild and Scatter Coat of Arms
features.description: King Henry acts as Wild. Scatter coats of arms on reels 1 and 5 unlock Free Spins with a choice of one of six Royal Wives.

features.title: Guillotine and turning Wild
features.description: In Free Spins, the guillotine removes Royal Wives in sequence; each eliminated character becomes Wild until the series ends.

features.title: Long Live the King
features.description: A reel can be chosen for the last wife: a successful execution unlocks a treasure hunt in which chests must be picked, ghost wives avoided and a multiplier key found.

intro: DJ Cat pays for numbered CD Symbols: neighbouring discs form a combined two-digit or longer number. VIP Symbols raise one of five Multiplier Meter tracks.
Arrow Symbols add height to an individual reel, while Push Up opens more active rows. The win therefore depends on both CD digits and grid expansion with meters of up to x100.
push-gaming-dj-cat.editorial: In DJ Cat, Arrows trigger reel expansion, while VIPs fill multipliers. This differs from DJ Fox, where VIPs can increase height at the same time.

features.title: CD Symbols
features.description: Neighbouring numbers on discs combine into a composite prize value.

features.title: VIP Meter
features.description: One VIP increases the meter by one, while Double VIP adds two.

features.title: Arrow and Push Up
features.description: Arrows increase reel height; Push Up activates extra rows.

intro: 9 Coins 1000 Edition retains nine positions and no payouts on ordinary spins. Three bonus symbols in the middle row trigger Hold the Jackpot with resetting respins.
Cash Infinity remains until the bonus and contributes its own values. The provider confirms the main numerical difference from the original: the Grand Jackpot increases from 500x to 1000x the stake.
wazdan-9-coins-1000-edition.editorial: 1000 Edition changes the Grand Jackpot ceiling without turning nine positions into a conventional payline slot; Buy Feature separately offers several bonus-entry variants.

features.title: Grand Jackpot 1000x
features.description: Filling all nine positions awards the top prize of 1000x the stake, twice the original.

features.title: Cash Infinity and Collector
features.description: Cash Infinity remains until Hold the Jackpot, while Collector gathers coin values and boosts them with a random multiplier.

features.title: Four Buy Feature levels
features.description: The provider describes four bonus-entry purchase options with different starting bonus-symbol counts.

intro: In Big Heist, three Safe Scatters unlock free spins.
Collect gathers all Money Symbols, while Super Collect attracts other Collect symbols.
3-oaks-gaming-big-heist.editorial: The Collect and Super Collect meter raises the free-spins level and can award a multiplier of up to x10.

features.title: Free spins
features.description: Three or more Safe Scatters trigger the bonus.

features.title: Collect and Super Collect
features.description: Both gather cash, while Super Collect attracts new Collect symbols.

features.title: Progress
features.description: The meter unlocks higher levels and multipliers of up to x10.

intro: Treasure Chest expands into a Wild Reel if it contributes to a win after expansion; one of three characters with its own multiplier range appears on that reel.
In Deep Blue, Wild Reels can receive lives and remain Sticky on subsequent spins; in Last Chance, respins continue while any Wild Reel has lives remaining.
hacksaw-gaming-dorks-of-the-deep.editorial: Dorks of the Deep gives reel value a lifetime: Treasure Chest turns it into a Wild Reel, while the bonus adds lives that keep it on the grid and assign a new multiplier each spin.

features.title: Treasure Chest creates a Wild Reel
features.description: Treasure Chest expands into a Wild Reel if this produces a win. Octopus, Mermaid or Ocean King appears on the reel with its own multiplier range; multiple contributing reels add their values together.

features.title: Deep Blue and Last Chance
features.description: In Deep Blue, Treasure Chest expands regardless of a win, while Wild Reels can receive up to three lives and remain Sticky. If lives remain when Free Spins end, Last Chance extends play through respins.

features.title: Down Under and Hidden Treasures
features.description: In Down Under, a Sticky Wild Reel cannot fall below its initial character level when receiving a new multiplier. Hidden Treasures retains these rules and constantly keeps at least two expanded Wild Reels on the grid.

intro: The main mechanic revolves around Buffalo Stacks and Expanding Reels. As the reels expand, Dynamic Payways increase; the official Play’n GO page states a maximum of 12,348 ways.

Buffalo symbols remain the central high-paying symbols and receive visual enhancement in Free Spins. The provider directly links the game’s pace to a dynamically growing number of paylines/ways rather than a fixed 5x3 grid.
playn-go-beasts-of-fire.editorial: Beasts of Fire makes changing reel size its main source of variety: Buffalo Stacks become more valuable as the expanding grid opens more Dynamic Payways, up to 12,348.

features.title: Buffalo Stacks and Dynamic Payways
features.description: Expanding Reels increase the available ways to 12,348, while Buffalo Stacks use the expanded grid for longer combinations.

features.title: Buffalo Stacks
features.description: The game emphasises large Buffalo symbol groups contributing to combinations on expanding reels.

features.title: Expanding Reels
features.description: Reel height changes dynamically, so the available ways to win are not fixed as on a standard 5×3 grid.

features.title: Dynamic Payways up to 12,348
features.description: Play’n GO states an upper limit of 12,348 ways; this number refers to the expanded grid rather than a guaranteed payout.

intro: DJ Fox builds wins around Vinyl Symbols: consecutive digits form two- or three-digit values. VIP Symbols expand a reel by one row and fill the meter at the same time.
After expansion, VIPs visible on the active reel collect in the Multiplier Meter, and the reels receive a respin. The meter can reach x20 and sometimes retain progress for the next paid spin.
push-gaming-dj-fox.editorial: DJ Fox is more than a recoloured DJ Cat: VIP triggers expansion, Vinyl symbols form a number, and the meter reaches x20 rather than DJ Cat’s verified x100.

features.title: Vinyl Symbols
features.description: Digits on vinyl symbols combine into a two- or three-digit prize.

features.title: VIP Respin
features.description: VIPs increase the active reel’s height, collect in the meter and trigger a respin.

features.title: Meter up to x20
features.description: The Multiplier Meter can retain its accumulated level for the next paid spin.

intro: 9 Coins Extremely Light uses nine positions with the same Hold the Jackpot foundation as the original 9 Coins. Its purpose is a lighter game for mobile devices and unstable connections rather than a new prize-rule set.
Cash Infinity still locks until the bonus, while filling all nine positions awards the Grand Jackpot of 500x the stake. Graphics and animation are simplified, but collection logic remains.
wazdan-9-coins-extremely-light.editorial: In Extremely Light, technical optimisation should be distinguished from a new game mechanic. Its bonus values and top jackpot should not be confused with 1000 Edition or Grand Diamond.

features.title: Simplified presentation
features.description: The provider reduced visual load and animations so the game requires fewer device resources.

features.title: Cash Infinity and Hold the Jackpot
features.description: Cash Infinity coins stay and help trigger respins; three bonus symbols in the middle row unlock the mode.

features.title: Grand Jackpot 500x
features.description: Filling all nine bonus positions awards 500x, as in the original version.

intro: In Black Wolf, Boost gathers the values of visible moon Bonus Symbols.
Six moons, or five moons together with Boost, trigger Hold & Win.
3-oaks-gaming-black-wolf.editorial: A Mystery Symbol becomes a jackpot in the bonus, while filling the grid can award the Grand Jackpot.

features.title: Boost
features.description: Gathers the values of all visible Moon Bonus Symbols.

features.title: Hold & Win
features.description: Moons lock, while each new symbol restores three respins.

features.title: Free spins
features.description: More Boost and Bonus Symbols appear in free spins.

intro: Charred Land acts as a Wild Multiplier with three charges: contributing to a win costs one charge, while each cascade increases its multiplier by one.
After cascades finish, Dragon Symbols breathe Dragonfire in a cross: the fire removes ordinary symbols and restores Charred Land charges, while Gold Dragon also multiplies its value.
hacksaw-gaming-dragons-domain.editorial: Dragon's Domain builds cascades around Charred Land: the position strengthens with every new cascade but spends charges on wins, so Dragonfire both extends the Wild’s lifetime and can sharply increase its multiplier.

features.title: Charred Land spends charges
features.description: Charred Land substitutes for symbols as a Wild Multiplier with three charges: contributing to a win spends a charge, while each subsequent cascade increases its multiplier by one.

features.title: Dragonfire from red and gold dragons
features.description: When cascades end, Dragon burns ordinary symbols in a cross and restores Charred Land charges. Gold Dragon also multiplies the affected Wild’s value and can boost discovered eggs.

features.title: Dragon’s Lair and The Hatchery
features.description: Three FS symbols trigger Dragon’s Lair, with Charred Land persisting between spins until its charges run out. Four FS symbols award The Hatchery, where Dragonfire collects cash Dragon Eggs instead of ordinary paying symbols.

intro: Charging Fire Beasts can add extra Buffalo symbols on any spin. Each Scatter that lands increases the reel area by another row while the remaining reels continue stopping.
Three Scatters trigger Maximum Burning Spins: the reels immediately reach maximum height, while Fire Beasts continue adding Buffalo symbols on the expanded grid.
playn-go-beasts-of-fire-maximum.editorial: Beasts of Fire Maximum makes grid expansion more direct than the original: each Scatter physically adds a row before the bonus is determined, while three Scatters fix maximum height for Maximum Burning Spins.

features.title: Charging Fire Beasts and Maximum Burning Spins
features.description: Fire Beasts add Buffalo symbols, Scatters expand the reels one row at a time, and three Scatters trigger Free Spins at maximum height.

features.title: Charging Fire Beasts
features.description: A random effect can add extra Buffalo Symbols to the reels.

features.title: Scatter increases the reel area
features.description: Each Scatter that lands adds one row while the reels stop; this differs from expansion in the original Beasts of Fire.

features.title: Maximum Burning Spins
features.description: Three Scatters trigger the bonus with the grid already fully expanded. Charging Fire Beasts can continue adding Buffalo Symbols during Free Spins.

intro: Dragon Hopper uses Wild Dragon with x1, x2, x3, x4, x5 and x10 multipliers. Jumping to a Fire Cloud increases the dragon’s multiplier by +1, leaving a Golden Dragon in the previous position.
Mystic Flare can appear after a non-winning cascade and add large Mystery Symbols of 2×2, 3×3 or 4×4. Three Scatters unlock Free Spins, retaining some base-game symbols and instant prizes.
push-gaming-dragon-hopper.editorial: In Dragon Hopper, Wild Dragon creates a chain of copies and collects Fire Cloud. This is separate from Bubble Symbols, which move upwards during the bonus.

features.title: Dragon Jump
features.description: Wild Dragon collects Fire Cloud, increases its multiplier by +1 and leaves a Golden Dragon.

features.title: Mystic Flare
features.description: After a non-winning cascade, Mystery Symbols measuring between 2×2 and 4×4 can appear.

features.title: Bubble Feature
features.description: A bubble carrying a value rises through the grid and can affect Fire Cloud, Golden Dragon and Instant Prize.

intro: 9 Coins Grand Diamond Edition retains the Cash Infinity and Hold the Jackpot architecture but adds Chance Level and Cash Out. It changes more than the size of the top prize.
Cash Out accumulates bonus-symbol values and pays part of them after twenty spins. Chance Level allows a higher stake for more frequent bonuses, while this version’s Grand Jackpot reaches 5000x.
wazdan-9-coins-grand-diamond-edition.editorial: Diamond Edition differs from Platinum in two details: a stated top prize of 5000x and its own base-game Cash Out. These figures should not be transferred to other 9 Coins versions.

features.title: Cash Out after twenty spins
features.description: A separate Cash Out area accumulates the values of bonus symbols landing on it and pays part of the amount after twenty spins.

features.title: Chance Level
features.description: Increasing the stake can raise the probability of entering Hold the Jackpot; the provider states a possible stake multiplier of up to x10.

features.title: Grand Jackpot 5000x
features.description: Filling nine bonus positions is linked to the top jackpot of 5000x the stake, rather than Platinum’s 2500x.

intro: In Black Wolf 2, Boost gathers Full Moon Symbol values, while Mystery turns into a valuable symbol or jackpot.
Six Bonus, Boost or Mystery Symbols trigger Hold & Win.
3-oaks-gaming-black-wolf-2.editorial: Fortune Slide sets a queue of valuable symbols: Mystery always turns into the first one.

features.title: Fortune Slide
features.description: The queue contains Bonus, Jackpot and Boost Symbols.

features.title: Three respins
features.description: Only Bonus and Mystery Symbols remain in the bonus.

features.title: Second route
features.description: Bonus Accum can also trigger Hold & Win.

intro: After current wins are calculated, Drop Symbol falls down, pulling the symbols above it along; empty positions then fill with one randomly selected matching symbol type.

In Drop Spins, the possible Drop-symbol pool includes the entire set, while FS can award extra spins or an Upgrade that removes low-paying symbols from the pool; High Drop starts with a high-paying pool immediately.
hacksaw-gaming-dropem.editorial: Drop'em changes the grid through a separate Drop event rather than a cascade after every win: one symbol reshapes a column, after which Canny fills new positions with one selected type.

features.title: Drop Symbol reshapes a column
features.description: After ordinary payouts, Drop Symbol falls down and shifts the symbols above it. Canny chooses one type to fill all newly empty positions, after which a new win is possible.

features.title: Drop Spins and symbol-pool Upgrades
features.description: Three FS symbols unlock ten Drop Spins. Additional FS symbols can award new spins or an Upgrade that progressively removes the lowest-paying symbols from the possible Drop set, but never Wild.

features.title: High Drop and rare Wild Drop
features.description: Four FS symbols trigger High Drop with a high-paying-only pool. Five FS symbols unlock Wild Drop Spins, where Drop fills exclusively with Wilds; this highest version cannot be bought directly.
